creditReachNote: tallyCredits reach kinds: 'victim' resolves to the group named by the deed subject's groupId; 'witness' resolves to any group whose id appears in the entry's witnessedBy, or whose member ids appear there via the caller-supplied witnessGroupIndex; 'area' resolves to the group whose homeAreaId equals the entry's areaId. Credits fire ONLY for witnessed deeds (witnessedBy non-empty) — an unseen deed moves morale and nothing else (#269/#270 split). Amount credited is the row's |value| unless the credit carries its own amount. The crossed case (stealing FROM the Syndicate, witnessed by a town, credits the town's fame) is authored per group at P2 when group instances exist; it is deliberately not encoded in this base table.
neglectNote: Neglect is a deed-CLASS, not rows in this vocabulary (BOND-DECAY-SPEC §2/§6): neglect tallies (types N1 absence / N2 care-starvation / N3 harsh use / N4 misplacement) are written by the systems that own the underlying events, and ledger entries for them carry context.neglect { type, subjectContext: party|storage|daycare|garden } plus context and witnesses, so the moral register can consume the same tallies. Neglect deed VALUES are an owner/balancing slot; P0 carries the fields the context×personality model needs (context + witnesses on every entry) and assigns no values.
note: Closed deed vocabulary for the honor system (List 28 #269), landed by the honor wiring P0 (2026-10-29). The deed table — not code — owns meaning: each row's value moves #269 morale (derived at read time by src/lib/honor.ts, never stored), and its tallyCredits say which groups a WITNESSED deed reaches and to which pile (#270). Values are DRAFTED system data from the List 28 morale fragment, tunable at landing; the vocabulary and the law are the spec. Owner slots (TRANSFER-MAP §5): deed values and any Mochiichao-specific deeds are canon (§5.2); story caps / stakes multipliers (§5.5) — the storyModifiers fields below are specced so that decision is a data row, never a code change; both ship EMPTY (nothing in force).

pacing.badDeeds: debit without a daily cap — falling is always available (#269/#275)
pacing.capNote: The daily good cap is applied at derivation, bucketing positive deed values by in-game day. The bucket is floor(beat / beatsPerDay); beatsPerDay is supplied by the caller because the #19 world-clock producer is not in code yet (BW2/HGSS wiring GAP-2). When no beatsPerDay is supplied, derivation applies NO cap and reports goodCapApplied: false — it never guesses a day length.

rampNote: Rows may carry ramp { streakKey, step, max }: consecutive ledger entries sharing the streakKey (in ledger order) deepen the row's value by step per extra entry, bounded by max (for negative rows, max is the floor). This is RDR2's streak ramping via the honor-west TRANSFER-MAP §1.2 refinement 1 — a spree must feel different from a slip. A beat-windowed ramp is a data addition when the world clock lands; P0 ramps on consecutive entries.
samplingNote: Rows may carry sampling { every: N }: only every Nth occurrence of the deed credits morale/tallies (TRANSFER-MAP §1.2 refinement 2 — ambient courtesies cannot be farmed by repetition). No row in the current closed vocabulary is an ambient courtesy, so no row carries sampling yet; the library and schema support it, and the library tests exercise it with a fixture table.
